Mr. International is very happy at The olive on Ho Chi Minh City
Jan 2026 • Solo
Extraordinary experience for these reasons. I found this treasure by curiosity and chance. I maneuvered through an art painting she, then down a covered alley, up a beautiful enchanting concrete curved staircases up yet fights. I was greater by an alert waitress. Seated in a very private charming area right near a window with a view of the famous Saigon Opera house. 
The wonderful waitress assisted to order. The recommendation was shot on good. 200grams of beef steak medium with rose pasta. It was good. I would say the steaks and pasta were home runs. The strawberry lime soda though was okay. Butt the drink presented well. I enjoyed the peace, privacy and solitude do much I filled up for the house cheeseburger. No regrets. Outstanding experience. Come on a Sunday and at 3-5 pm and you will enjoy some peaceful calm in an old part of Saigon that still exist. I highly recommend as I do not expect developers to slower this valuable piece of land to remain as it currently is. The floors, bathroom, walls are all real Saigon of another era. 
You can pass done time slow reading and looking out three window to do some peaceful people watching. 

Waitress was outstanding for being kind, multilingual, familiar with the history of the area.

Small steakhouse In Downtown HCMC
Jan 2026 • Friends
Small dingy place. Only positive is the location and friendly service. 
3 of us dropped in for lunch as it was near our hotel. The steaks that we had were nothing to write home about.. The meat was a bit chewy and rubbery and not very well seasoned. The black pepper sauce lacked depth of flavour. The prawns salad we had was just OK. All in all, quite a let down, and for almost 95 Usd for the 3 of us, definitely not worth it
